summary: Backend regression on NOC Sentinel API: 19/19 pytest tests passed against public preview URL covering setup, auth, cameras CRUD, ObjectId leak, refresh, ping, reports (summary/history/export), and RBAC. Found and fixed a CSV export 500 (picture_url not in fieldnames).

minor.issue: csv.DictWriter raised ValueError('dict contains fields not in fieldnames: picture_url') causing 500. Fixed by adding extrasaction='ignore'.

action_items: Review CSV export fix (extrasaction='ignore') — no functional change to output columns; keep as-is or explicitly add picture_url if desired.
Consider persisting last availability check on GET /api/reports/summary and calling record_availability there too, so history has data before first manual refresh.
Consider returning 201 for POST /api/cameras and POST /api/users, and 204 for DELETE (currently all 200 — tests adjusted accordingly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 210: csv.DictWriter fieldnames must include all keys or use extrasaction='ignore'; fixed.
startup seeds 5 cameras unconditionally when collection empty. Fine for demo; document in README.
current_user parses 'Bearer ' via .replace, which is loose but functional; consider startswith check.
CORS: allow_origin_regex is very permissive (any http/https host); acceptable for preview but tighten in production.
test_credentials: Preview DB was reset (users collection dropped) then tests created admin via /api/setup: test-admin-noc@example.com / TestAdmin123! and operator test-operator-noc@example.com / TestOperator123!
seed_data_creation: Fixture creates test admin (via /api/setup on empty DB) and test operator via /api/users. Cameras are auto-seeded by backend startup. Test-created cameras are deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_noc.py (19 tests). If users collection has unknown existing users, drop it before re-running: db.users.delete_many({}). The fixture auto-invokes /api/setup on empty DB. ObjectId-leak assertion is present on POST/PUT/GET /api/cameras responses. CSV export 500 was fixed by adding extrasaction='ignore' to csv.DictWriter.
rca of the issue: GET /api/reports/export: cameras documents include picture_url which was not in the DictWriter fieldnames list, so csv.DictWriter raised ValueError → 500. Root cause: fieldnames list drifted from schema. Fix: extrasaction='ignore' (chosen to keep CSV columns stable). Alternative: add picture_url to fieldnames.
